gripOrHq.title: Omnitech Wet Drive
gripOrHq.rulesText: Your base MU is equal to the number of cards in your hand instead of 4.

gripOrHq.title: Superglue
gripOrHq.rulesText: [T]: Derez a piece of ice. Use this ability only if you have just broken all the subroutines of that piece of ice.

gripOrHq.title: Executive File Clerk
gripOrHq.rulesText: [2],[T]: Look at all cards stored in HQ. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

gripOrHq.title: Schematics Search Engine
gripOrHq.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from HQ, expose all of the Corp's installed cards.

heapOrArchives.title: Panzer Run
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Gain [4] and draw two cards. Playing a double prep costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

rig.title: Psychic Friend
rig.rulesText: [1]: Break code gate subroutine. [2]: +1 strength until end of turn

rig.title: MS-todon
rig.rulesText: [1]: Break sentry subroutine. [1]: +1 strength. The first time during each run that you break a sentry subroutine with MS-todon, lose all bits from all stealth cards, if you can, and the Corp gives you a tag.

root.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
root.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.
